definitions.gloss: throughout the world, all over the world
definitions.explanation: In every part of the world; worldwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This song is popular all over the world.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to travel around the world.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: People all over the world know about this news.

notes:
{世界中|せかいじゅう} means all over the world or worldwide. It emphasizes that something covers or applies to the entire globe.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (world) + {中|じゅう} (throughout, all over).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: all over the world (location)
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: ~ from all over the world (modifier)
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel around the world
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧: known worldwide

SIMILAR 〜{中|じゅう} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{日本中|にほんじゅう}→日本中：28045_nihonjuu⟧: throughout Japan
- ⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧: throughout the town
- {家中|いえじゅう}: throughout the house
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧: all day long

NOTE ON {中|じゅう} vs. ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧:
The suffix {中|じゅう} means "throughout" (spatial or temporal). It is different from ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧, which means "in the middle of" or "during" (e.g., ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧, during a meeting).
